text.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًۭا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ نِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَٰمِلِينَ

baseline.text: İnanıp iyi işler yapanları cennette, altından ırmaklar akan yüksek odalara yerleştireceğiz. Orada sürekli kalacaklar. Çalışanların ödülü ne güzeldir!

findings.text: Yerleştirme, çalışanın sürdürdüğü iyi eylemin ona uygun hazırlanmış bir ikamet düzeni olarak geri dönmesidir.
Sürekli kalış, donuk bir hareketsizlik değildir; ırmakların devam eden akışıyla beslenen istikrarlı bir aidiyettir.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent identifies the entrants and supplies the trust side of the qualifying pair.
Intentional action appears as both deed and agent, binding conduct to the promised outcome.
Repair opposed to corruption qualifies the actions as order-making rather than activity alone.
Preparing and taking a dwelling makes the promise an act of deliberate emplacement.
A garden screened by its growth supplies the enclosing habitat.
The upper room supplies a stable elevated residential layer.
Water in active flow keeps the habitat dynamic rather than inert.
The lower direction fixes the flow as a supporting stratum beneath the rooms.
A river channel cut through earth gives the lower flow durable form.
Persistence resistant to decay converts lodging into lasting residence.

changed_reading.after: Believing workers are deliberately installed in a vertically ordered, self-renewing, and enduring habitat.
changed_reading.before: Believers receive an unspecified pleasant reward.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The qualifying deeds at words 2-4, emplacement at word 5, upper rooms at word 8, lower rivers at words 9-12, and abiding at word 13.
baseline_models.mechanism: Trusted assent and deliberately reparative action are answered by emplacement in an elevated, enduring garden habitat. The promise is spatially organized: prepared residence above, active water below, and permanence joining occupant to place.

activation_trace.role: Fitness and suitability make the deeds apt for the habitat that follows.
The condition or configuration of a stay lets emplacement denote a transformed state as well as a location.
A place that agrees with its occupant and makes residence pleasant supplies the criterion of fit.
Work recompense closes the correspondence between action and fitted outcome.

changed_reading.after: The reward is a condition and dwelling made fitting to the repaired quality of their action.
changed_reading.before: The reward is a valuable destination externally added to the recipients.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of suitable deeds, emplacement, pleasant praise, and reward at words 4-16.
baseline_models.mechanism: The result fits the action: deeds characterized by fitness and repair are answered by a fitting mode and place of residence. Reward is therefore environmental correspondence, not only an added possession.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful doing links the initial deeds to the final identity of their doers.
The wage of labor makes the repeated action root resonate with compensation.
Payment or recompense gives the praise a work-reward structure.
The explicit praise evaluates the recompense as excellent.

changed_reading.after: Intentional deeds mature into a worker identity whose recompense is publicly praised.
changed_reading.before: A believing group passively receives a gift.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same action root occurs as the deed at word 3 and the workers at word 17, with reward at word 16.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse converts acts into an agent identity and then names the outcome as work recompense. The closing praise recognizes not isolated outputs but people formed as workers by repeated intentional action.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment give the garden a protective envelope.
A defensive shield sharpens the envelope into active protection.
Prepared dwelling turns protection into inhabitable refuge.
Enduring stability prevents the refuge from becoming temporary cover.

changed_reading.after: The garden rooms form a permanently inhabitable shield against exposure and loss.
changed_reading.before: Garden and rooms mainly signal beauty and rank.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Garden at word 7 is joined to prepared residence at word 5 and permanence at word 13.
baseline_models.mechanism: The garden can function as concealment and shield as well as vegetation. Prepared lodging inside that protection, made permanent, answers exposure with durable refuge.

activation_trace.role: An encompassing flood supplies water as a settlement-destroying surround.
Escape by separation supplies release from the flood's enclosure.
A vessel cutting the water's face supplies temporary habitable passage across it.
Drowning restores water's lethal, engulfing capacity later in the sequence.
Water delivered by pouring or irrigation supplies its ordered nourishing role.
Earth made alive by rain supplies the causal result of ordered water.
Flowing converts water from an engulfing mass into sustained movement.
Placement beneath the rooms subordinates water spatially to habitation.
Earth-cut channels contain and distribute the flow.

changed_reading.after: The rivers are destructive water tamed, routed, and made the continuous life-support layer of permanent habitation.
changed_reading.before: The rivers are conventional decorative abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah water surrounds and destroys, bears a rescue vessel, drowns, and revives dead earth. In the focus it is no longer an uncontrolled boundary or catastrophe: it runs in durable channels beneath inhabited rooms. The element that can erase settlement is reordered into its life-supporting substrate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destructive, transportive, and reviving water plus channelled water beneath rooms; I infer a reversal from uncontrolled power to sustaining infrastructure. A live alternative is that these are independent water signs rather than a designed transformation.
structural_cues: 29:14-15 pairs an encompassing flood with rescue in a vessel.
29:40 includes drowning among several destructions of settled peoples.
29:63 presents descending water as reviving dead earth, while 29:58 places flowing rivers under the residence.

activation_trace.role: Leaving one abode for another supplies the surah's explicit residential displacement.
Loss of life makes every earthly lodging nonfinal.
Return supplies the directional transition immediately before emplacement.
A prepared abode supplies the destination that resolves displacement.
Upper rooms give the returned migrants an actual residential destination.
Permanence terminates the cycle of having to depart again.

changed_reading.after: The rooms are the final re-housing of people who leave, traverse, die, return, and are at last placed where departure ends.
changed_reading.before: The rooms are fixed reward property unrelated to the recipients' movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Departure from one dwelling toward another, the immediate declaration of death, and return all turn the focus emplacement into terminal re-housing. The upper rooms answer serial displacement: migration crosses houses and broad earth, death removes every temporary address, and return ends in a prepared place that no longer has to be left.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies migration, spatial breadth, death, return, and prepared permanent rooms; I infer that emplacement answers displacement as final re-housing. The alternative is a general reward sequence without a migration-specific residential arc.
structural_cues: 29:26 explicitly names migration toward the Lord.
29:56 tells believers that the earth is spacious and redirects worship accordingly.
29:57 places universal death and return immediately before 29:58's emplacement promise.

activation_trace.role: Settled homes whose remains are visible supply habitation that failed to preserve its occupants.
Repeated shelter and dwelling language makes built dependence the comparison's material center.
Loss of strength marks that shelter as structurally unable to secure its dependants.
Divinely prepared dwelling reverses the failed act of taking an inadequate house.
Substantial upper rooms replace the weak shelter with durable architecture.
Endurance supplies the exact property the earlier dwellings lack.

changed_reading.after: It replaces architectures of failed dependence with a divinely supported dwelling that can actually keep its occupants.
changed_reading.before: The focus simply upgrades believers to more splendid housing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah displays prior dwellings emptied by destruction and a patron-dependent house defined by maximal weakness. The focus therefore promises more than luxurious housing: divine emplacement replaces self-made or misplaced-dependence architecture with rooms whose support, flow, and permanence do not fail their occupants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ruined dwellings, an explicitly weak house, and permanent prepared rooms; I infer architectural replacement as a critique of failed dependence. The alternative is that the house comparison concerns allegiance only and does not extend materially to 29:58.
structural_cues: 29:37 leaves a people collapsed in their abode, and 29:38 points to former peoples through their dwellings.
29:41 repeats house three times and identifies the patron-dependent house as weakest.
29:58 combines prepared emplacement, upper rooms, sustaining flow, and permanence.

activation_trace.role: Intentional works supply conduct capable of orienting a life.
Turning aside makes corrupt work function as blockage rather than progress.
A traversable extended road supplies the route from which those works divert.
Effort expended under difficulty supplies the active counter-route.
Plural traversable ways supply the opened trajectory at the surah's close.
The deed-to-worker repetition turns the travelers' conduct into stable identity.
Emplacement supplies the route's residential terminus.

changed_reading.after: Work is practiced movement along or away from a way, and the promised rooms are the terminus of the rightly directed trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Action in the surah is directional: adorned works can bar a traversable way, while strenuous effort ends with opened ways. Because the focus repeats action as both deed and worker before emplacement, its reward becomes the destination of a practiced trajectory rather than the tally paid for disconnected acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated action formulas, a work-caused obstruction, effort, ways, and final emplacement; I infer a path-to-dwelling trajectory. The alternative is that route language and residential reward remain separate metaphors.
structural_cues: 29:7 first states the same belief, righteous-action, and recompense sequence as 29:58.
29:9 turns that sequence into admission among the righteous.
29:38 joins adorned works to obstruction of the way, while 29:69 joins striving to guidance along ways.

activation_trace.role: The upper direction supplies one side of punitive vertical enclosure.
The lower direction beneath the feet supplies the other side of enclosure.
Intentional action is named as the conduct tasted through that spatial consequence.
Upper rooms convert overhead space from threat into habitation.
The repeated lower direction now locates a sustaining river layer.
The repeated action root links the reversed spaces to contrasting outcomes of conduct.

changed_reading.after: The layout is a point-for-point reconstruction of the punitive vertical axis: threat above becomes residence, and threat below becomes sustaining flow.
changed_reading.before: Upper rooms and lower rivers merely describe paradise's layout.

context_deltas.mechanism: Three verses before the focus, action culminates in punishment occupying both the space above and the space beneath the feet. The focus repeats the action root and the lower-direction construction but rebuilds the axis: upper space becomes inhabitable rooms, lower space becomes flowing rivers, and the worker is supported rather than enclosed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated lower preposition, repeated action root, explicit upper punishment, and upper rooms; I infer a deliberate spatial inversion from enclosure to support. The alternative is simple juxtaposition of two fates without an architectonic reversal.
structural_cues: 29:54 describes Hell as already encompassing the disbelievers.
29:55 distributes punishment above and beneath their feet and closes by naming what they used to do.
29:58 distributes rooms above implied lower rivers and closes by praising the reward of workers.

activation_trace.role: Allotted gift locates provision with God before the focus's work-reward statement.
Labor's wage supplies the transactional pressure that the following cues qualify.
Work recompense makes a wage reading genuinely present rather than merely imposed.
Holding oneself against panic recasts work as endurance without immediate control of outcome.
Reliance transfers control of outcome beyond the worker.
Not lifting or carrying visible provision removes self-storage as the condition of sustenance.
Sustaining food is supplied to creature and audience by a provider other than themselves.
Expansion and abundance make provision a dispensed surplus, not mechanically fixed pay.
Allotted provision keeps divine distribution central after the worker language.

changed_reading.after: The workers' recompense is simultaneously provision: received through endurance and reliance and continuously maintained by its giver.
changed_reading.before: The rooms are wages possessed because sufficient labor was performed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's wage-like closure is immediately followed by patient endurance and reliance, then by creatures that do not carry their own provision and by divine allotment and expansion of provision. Work remains real, but the habitat cannot be reduced to a stored wage: workers act while depending on the provider who maintains the flow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wage language followed by endurance, reliance, non-carriage, and divine provisioning; I infer that provision qualifies rather than cancels recompense. A live alternative is that 29:59 begins an independent description and leaves the wage model more transactional.
structural_cues: 29:17 directs the search for provision to God.
29:58 ends with the reward of workers, and 29:59 immediately describes those who endure and rely.
29:60 denies that every creature carries its provision; 29:62 assigns its expansion and restriction to God.

activation_trace.role: Living being and vital life intensify the later home as life in an active sense.
Association with a house and residence supplies the frame in which true life is located.
Being occupied away from the real object marks present life as displaced attention.
Action without a sound aim contrasts with the focus's purposive righteous work.
Ongoing flow gives the promised home visible vitality.
Enduring continuity distinguishes true life from temporary diversion.

changed_reading.after: They are the habitat in which life becomes fully living, purposive, flowing, and continuous.
changed_reading.before: Permanent rooms are static compensation after life has ended.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast names present life as distraction and unserious play but the later home as life itself. This makes the focus's permanent rooms and moving rivers a living ecology rather than static posthumous real estate: the dwelling is where life finally has its proper continuity and purpose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a home identified with life, purposeless present activity, flowing water, and permanence; I infer that the rooms are an ecology of realized life. The alternative is that 29:64 only ranks two lives without characterizing the internal dynamics of 29:58.
structural_cues: 29:64 directly opposes this present life as distraction and play to the later home as the living life.
29:58 combines habitation, continuous flow, and abiding rather than presenting an inert treasure.

activation_trace.role: A spatial sanctuary supplies a bounded zone of protection.
Security and belief share the root in one verse, making trusted assent spatially habitable.
Rapid seizure supplies the surrounding danger from which sanctuary protects.
The space around the sanctuary maps security against its exposed perimeter.
Beneficent good names security itself as a bestowed blessing.
A rival lodging supplies the negative destination against which the focus residence is secured.
Inner security within the believers' root becomes the qualification for protected placement.
A shield makes the garden the material realization of security.
Permanence prevents protected status from lapsing back into exposure.

changed_reading.after: The security latent in faith becomes inhabitable and permanent: the garden is belief's completed sanctuary against seizure and rival emplacement.
changed_reading.before: Faith is assent that is later rewarded with a safe place.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later places sanctuary, security, belief, blessing, surrounding space, and sudden seizure in one frame, then names a rival lodging for disbelievers. This activates the security branch already latent in the focus's belief root: faith is completed as durable protected habitation, while surrounding seizure and the rival lodging define what that security excludes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies security and belief in one root, sanctuary, surrounding seizure, blessing, rival lodging, and the focus's shielded permanence; I infer that semantic security is realized as residence. The alternative is analogy between two protected places rather than projection of one sanctuary pattern into the garden.
structural_cues: 29:67 sets a secure sanctuary against people being seized from around it and juxtaposes belief with ingratitude for blessing.
29:68 immediately names Hell as a lodging for disbelievers.
29:58 begins with belief and ends with permanently shielded emplacement.

remaining_uncertainties: The link from 29:59 back to the workers of 29:58 is contextually strong but its exact grammatical dependence remains open.
The flood-to-river and route-to-room mechanisms may be designed reversals or cumulative analogies rather than strict one-to-one correspondences.
The high-ground, hydraulic, and reparative readings must remain exploratory because they depend on non-dominant branch images.
strongest_changes: The punitive above-and-below enclosure of 29:55 is rebuilt in 29:58 as inhabitable height over sustaining lower flow.
Migration, death, and return turn prepared rooms into final re-housing, while ruined and weak houses make them replacement architecture.
The reward-of-workers frame is qualified by patience, reliance, non-carried provision, and divine distribution.
Security latent in belief becomes a permanent sanctuary against surrounding seizure and rival lodging.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah activation made small spatial repetitions and dwelling roots do causal work: water changes from engulfing force to routed support, action becomes a path, and security becomes architecture. The most diagnostic branch-distant survivals are saved high ground, hydraulic receiving rooms, and reward as repair.

activation_trace.role: Encompassing flood supplies the water field from which elevation matters.
Elevated land that escapes damage turns rescue into a possible high-ground image.
Upper rooms supply permanent inhabited high ground.
Water placed below fixes the rooms above the former threat.
Permanence converts temporary escape terrain into enduring residence.

changed_reading.after: They also faintly resemble permanent saved high ground: inhabited elevation with the once-encompassing water safely below.
changed_reading.before: The upper rooms signify only rank and comfort.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the topographic branch of rescue as elevated surviving ground rather than replacing the ordinary rescue sense. It remains anchored through the flood-rescue sequence and the focus's upper rooms with water below. Downstream prose should present it as a spatial echo, not as the lexical translation of either verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Upper rooms at word 8 stand over rivers at words 11-12.

activation_trace.role: Lifting and taking a portion supplies a receiving or raised-draw image within the room word.
The ordinary upper room keeps the activation architecturally anchored.
Continuing provision or grant makes the flow function as maintained supply.
Opening and widening until flow supplies the channel-forming operation.
Delivery by watering or pouring supplies a whole-surah analogue for hydraulic provisioning.
Rain-generated life identifies the delivered flow's productive result.

changed_reading.after: The rooms can be carried as raised receiving habitats continuously supplied by opened, life-producing flow beneath them.
changed_reading.before: Rooms sit above ornamental moving water.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the scooping or lifting branch of the room root coexist with its normal upper-room branch and reads architecture hydraulically. It remains anchored in the exact room, flow, river, and below construction, sharpened by life-giving delivered water at 29:63. Downstream prose should label it material wordplay, not substitute 'scoops' for 'rooms.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The contiguous construction of rooms, flowing, beneath, and rivers at words 8-12.

activation_trace.role: Setting a break on its bend supplies a latent image of recompense as repair.
Repair opposed to corruption gives the action side the same restorative direction.
A configured state of residence lets repair culminate in a righted condition.
Durability makes the repaired condition hold rather than relapse.

changed_reading.after: Reward also carries an exploratory reparative resonance: the workers are set right into a condition that remains whole.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant broken-bone repair branch of the reward root. It remains anchored in the exact reward word beside deeds characterized by repair and an emplacement verb that can denote condition. Downstream prose should call it reparative resonance, never the direct lexical sense of reward here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Righteous deeds at word 4, emplacement at word 5, and reward at word 16.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A prepared settlement that returns what action incurred.** ب و ء B001 contains both settling/preparing a place and settling into an abode; B002 is returning with what comes back upon one or is incurred. Faith and action precede prepared chambers, flowing rivers, and lasting residence. I infer correspondence between practiced action and fitted abode; the promise reads both as emplacement and as the good condition that returns upon the workers.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:64 names the later abode as the living reality, sharpening ب و ء B001: the promised chambers are not merely safer lodging but emplacement within durable life.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **After migration and death, faithful workers are deliberately resettled above sustaining flow.** Lexical evidence: `لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم`, root `ب و ء`, `B001` (settling and preparing a place); `ٱلْجَنَّة`, root `ج ن ن`, `B003` (tree-covered garden); `غُرَفًا`, root `غ ر ف`, `B002` (upper chamber); `تَجْرِى`, root `ج ر ي`, `B001` (running and flowing); and `ٱلْأَنْهَار`, root `ن ه ر`, `B001` (river cutting ground with flowing water). Structural cue: `29:56` opens wide earth, `29:57` crosses death, and this ayah supplies prepared upper lodging with rivers beneath. Assigned role: settlement gives durable placement; chambers elevate; flowing water sustains from below. Abductive move: I infer a repaired spatial order in contrast to `29:55`'s threat from above and below. Reading change: reward is an inhabitable, provisioned environment rather than an abstract credit.

2. **Permanence is sustained course, not lifeless stasis.** Lexical evidence: `خَالِدِين`, root `خ ل د`, `B001` (enduring permanence); `تَجْرِى`, root `ج ر ي`, `B002` (habitual course or way); `أَجْر`, root `ء ج ر`, `B001` (recompense for work); and `ٱلْعَامِلِين`, root `ع م ل`, `B001` (intentional workers). Structural cue: permanent residence is grammatically embedded beside ongoing river motion, then praised as the workers' recompense. Assigned role: recurrent flow maintains the permanent habitat; work is the matched accountable input. Abductive move: the packet does not say rivers cause permanence; I infer that endurance can include continuous provision rather than immobility. Reading change: abiding life is pictured as stable belonging supported by active flow.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later activation (`29:64`):** The immediate declaration that the later abode is `ٱلْحَيَوَان` identifies the prepared chambers as the architecture of true life. Their permanence is not merely endless duration; it is habitation aligned with undiverted vitality rather than near-life play.

words.gloss_range: opening connector that continues the prior death-return discourse while pivoting to the rewarded subset
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) does more than add a clause. It carries the prior death-and-return boundary into a new reward unit, so the universal return is immediately narrowed toward the qualified subset who will receive settlement. Its bound movement into the relative class marker makes transition and qualification arrive as one surface unit.

topics.headline: opening connector pivots from return to reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is not isolated; the prior return statement is redirected into a selective promise.
topics.reason: The opening connector coherently links the ayah to the prior boundary while launching the reward unit.

topics.headline: bound connector fuses transition to class marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the transition and the relative class arrive as one surface movement.
topics.reason: The form and sound rows add a local surface payoff without changing the syntax.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural relative pronoun that forms an action-defined class and suspends the predicate until the promise
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) names no individual group apart from its following actions. The fronted relative pronoun makes the reader hold an action-defined class in suspense until the oath-strengthened promise supplies its predicate, and that class opens the familiar faith-and-deeds reward formula.

topics.headline: relative pronoun creates known action-defined class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is identifiable only by the actions that follow, not by lineage or name.
topics.reason: The definite plural relative pronoun is licensed as the head of the qualifying relative clause.

topics.headline: fronted topic waits for the oath promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the promise delayed until the qualified group has been fully defined.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence supports the relative clause as the topic for the later promise.

topics.headline: faith-and-deeds formula opens reward frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the opening as a familiar reward formula joining faith with deeds.
topics.reason: The formulaic rows are coherent and do not override the local grammar.

words.gloss_range: completed plural believing as active trust-entry, paired with work in the reward qualification
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) presents belief as completed plural trust-entry before the divine promise begins. The {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) root keeps safety and entrusted fidelity in view, while the repeated formula joins that trust to enacted repair-work and to same-surah merit echoes (29:7; 29:9). The boundary also narrows universal address into a third-person believing subset, with the shared human-action cadence carrying into the work language.
words.root_gloss_range: safety, trust, security, entrusted fidelity, and faith; the local Form IV plural selects active believing or trust-entry in the reward formula

topics.headline: completed plural belief qualifies before promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same plural group already qualified by completed belief before the future promise begins.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence confirm the 3mp perfect verb belongs to the relative-clause subject.

topics.headline: safety and trust field selected as active faith
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief carries safety and entrusted fidelity, while local Form IV keeps the sense to active believing/trust-entry.
topics.reason: The broad root field is useful but narrowed to the local Form IV faith verb.

topics.headline: faith precedes work inside recurring merit triad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a repeated merit triad in which trust comes before enacted repair, with local payoff from earlier same-surah uses (29:7; 29:9).
topics.reason: The formula and same-surah echo rows are concrete and locally tied to the opening condition.

topics.headline: pronoun and sound thread narrow the audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary shift from universal address to a third-person believing subset, reinforced by the human-action sound thread.
topics.reason: The pronoun and phonetic observations add a small but coherent boundary payoff.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that makes faith and work cumulative co-qualifications under one relative head
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) binds the work-verb to the faith-verb under the same relative head. The particle keeps the two qualifications distinct but cumulative: belief is not collapsed into work, and work is not detached from belief.

topics.headline: second connector joins faith and work without collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that faith and work are paired requirements under one head, not two populations and not one flattened predicate.
topics.reason: The local conjunction is strongly licensed as coordinating the two verbs in the relative clause.

words.gloss_range: completed plural work governing the definite class of restorative deeds and framing later recompense
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) makes the same plural group into workers, not merely believers with an inward claim. The verb governs a definite object of restorative deeds, so the qualifier is purposeful labor with accountable output, and the {{ar:ع م ل}} ({{tr:ʿ-m-l}}) root later returns in the final worker-label, framing the ayah with labor.
words.root_gloss_range: purposeful work, labor, and accountable production; the local perfect verb selects completed enacted work paired with faith

topics.headline: same plural workers perform a definite object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same group move from faith into completed work directed at a known deed-category.
topics.reason: The verb shares the relative-clause subject and governs the following direct object.

topics.headline: work root frames productive accountable action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the qualifier is purposeful labor with output, not an undefined act.
topics.reason: The root and form claims fit the local transitive Form I perfect.

topics.headline: opening work returns as final worker identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that labor frames the ayah from opening qualification to final reward identity.
topics.reason: The local repetition and co-occurrence rows are concrete and compatible with the ayah structure.

words.gloss_range: recognized restorative deed-category functioning as the direct object of work
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāt}}) is the named object of the work, not a loose moral adjective. Its {{ar:ص ل ح}} ({{tr:ṣ-l-ḥ}}) root makes the deeds acts of soundness and repair, and its definite plural form presents a recognizable category before the promise begins. That repair-root completes the faith-work formula that has already appeared as a same-surah merit thread (29:7; 29:9).
words.root_gloss_range: soundness, fitness, repair, and moral rightness; the local definite plural selects recognized restorative deeds as the object of work

topics.headline: definite restorative deeds object closes qualification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that work is bounded by a recognizable class of deeds before the promise begins.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms the word as the direct object of the work verb.

topics.headline: soundness and repair define the deed category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deeds are repair-producing acts of soundness, not generic good behavior.
topics.reason: The root and participial noun rows remain locally active in the object phrase.

topics.headline: repair root completes the faith-work formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that repair completes the formula that links faith, work, paradise, and same-surah recurrence (29:7; 29:9).
topics.reason: The formula and echo evidence is concrete and does not displace the local object role.

words.gloss_range: oath/emphasis prefix fused to the coming settlement verb and reinforced by the energetic ending
